text:
Hi, I’m Noor Halden, a machine learning freelancer with 6 years of experience building and working with Python-based AI solutions.

I’d be a strong fit for this role because my background aligns closely with the technologies and responsibilities you listed. I work extensively with Python for machine learning and software development, and I’m comfortable with the practical details that matter when building reliable models and AI-driven applications. My toolkit includes PyTorch, scikit-learn, Hugging Face Transformers, LangChain, the OpenAI API, pandas, XGBoost, NLP, and machine learning.

Your posting emphasizes experience with machine learning and artificial intelligence, Python, PyTorch, and generative AI frameworks. That is exactly the area I focus on. I’m especially comfortable working with NLP workflows, transformer-based models, and LLM integrations, including open-source approaches and OpenAI-based implementations. I also understand the importance of debugging, iteration, and keeping the codebase clean and maintainable when working on complex Python systems.

I can help with tasks such as model development, experimentation, evaluation, prompt or pipeline design, and integrating machine learning components into Python applications. I’m also used to approaching problems analytically, choosing the right method for the task, and refining solutions based on performance and reliability requirements.

What I would bring to your team is not just familiarity with the tools, but a practical, hands-on approach to machine learning work. I’m comfortable moving between traditional ML methods and modern generative AI workflows, and I pay attention to both model quality and implementation details.

If you’re looking for someone who can contribute in Python, work confidently with PyTorch and NLP/LLM tooling, and support development on machine learning and AI tasks, I’d be glad to discuss the role further.

What specific machine learning or generative AI work is the top priority for this position?
